root_idea.summary: The root centers on perceiving something by the ear: hearing a sound or speech. From this core develop intentional listening, understanding and heeding speech, awareness of what is said, report and reputation, and objects likened to an ear.
root_idea.development: The lexical development proceeds from auditory perception to attentive listening, comprehension, acceptance or compliance, and things heard or made known. Related concrete extensions include the ear, hearing instruments, ear-like loops, and certain specialized animal and descriptive terms.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic form is represented by the normalized perfect citation form تَسَمَّعَ.
The initial hamzat al-waṣl is normalized in the citation form اِسْتَمَعَ.
Displayed as the passive participle مُسْمَع.
Displayed as the active participle مُسْمِع.
The Quranic plural occurrence is normalized to the singular active-participial citation form مُسْتَمِع.
The Quranic plural is normalized to the singular intensive active participle سَمَّاع.

senses.definition: to hear; perceive a sound or spoken expression by the ear
senses.usage_conditions: The basic auditory sense, whether the hearing is involuntary or deliberate; it may take a direct object.

senses.definition: to listen, hearken, or give ear
senses.usage_conditions: This intentional use is especially associated with constructions using لِ or إِلَى, though the verb may also express listening with a direct object.

senses.definition: to understand or comprehend what is said
senses.usage_conditions: Used of grasping the meaning of speech, not merely receiving its sound; this sense is explicit in Quranic passages contrasting hearing with failure to understand.

senses.definition: to heed and comply with an instruction
senses.usage_conditions: A consequence-oriented use in which hearing entails acting on what was heard, as in expressions of hearing and obeying.

senses.definition: to hear of or learn about something through report
senses.usage_conditions: The construction سَمِعَ بِهِ expresses learning of a matter or hearing it reported, rather than directly hearing its sound.

senses.definition: to take cognizance of or know what is said
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic descriptions of divine hearing, the verb can express awareness of spoken words together with the response or reckoning appropriate to them.

senses.definition: to cause someone to hear; make something audible to someone
senses.usage_conditions: The causative construction may be used of enabling or causing auditory perception, including its negation in descriptions of those unable to hear.

senses.definition: to make someone understand or comprehend
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction لَأَسْمَعَهُمْ, the causative result is understanding rather than merely receiving sound.

senses.definition: in أَسْمِعْ بِهِ, to express wonder at how clearly someone hears
senses.usage_conditions: This is the special exclamatory construction attested in Quranic usage; it is not an ordinary causative imperative.

senses.definition: to seek or endeavor to listen; listen attentively
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic reading uses the intensive/reflexive form for deliberately trying to hear what is being said.

senses.definition: to listen attentively; give close ear to something
senses.usage_conditions: The form emphasizes intentional orientation toward what is heard and commonly occurs with إِلَى or a directly specified object.

senses.definition: made to hear; granted or denied a hearing
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression غَيْرَ مُسْمَعٍ, the phrase is an ambiguous formula interpreted either as an imprecation not to be made to hear, or as hearing without receiving acceptable or assented-to speech.

senses.definition: one who causes or is able to make someone hear
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use is in a negated ability construction: ordinary agents cannot make the spiritually or physically unresponsive hear.

senses.definition: one who listens attentively; a listener
senses.usage_conditions: The participle denotes the participant deliberately giving ear, including a listener associated with or directed toward a particular speaker or matter.

senses.definition: hearing; possessing or displaying the capacity to hear
senses.usage_conditions: This adjectival use can describe a hearing being or a hearing faculty; it is distinct from the intensified divine epithet.

senses.definition: the All-Hearing; comprehending all that is heard
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a divine epithet in Quranic contexts, expressing comprehensive hearing and awareness of audible things.

senses.definition: the faculty or sense of hearing; the ear as the organ of hearing
senses.usage_conditions: The noun may refer to the auditory faculty and, by metonymy, to the ear or ears themselves; Quranic usage may use the singular collectively.

senses.definition: hearing or listening as an activity
senses.usage_conditions: This use denotes the act or exercise of hearing, including giving ear to a sound or communication.

senses.definition: an avid or habitual listener; one who listens and relays what is heard
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic constructions سَمَّاعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ and سَمَّاعُونَ لِقَوْمٍ آخَرِينَ, the listening is associated with false reporting or with listening on behalf of another party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to accept, pay regard to, answer, assent to, or comply with something said, requested, praised, or prayed for
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader classical extension from hearing to accepting or responding; it includes expressions concerning praise, prayer, evidence, or speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the act of making someone hear; causing a sound or narrative to reach someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal noun of Form II, including making someone hear a sound or report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to publicize, make notorious, spread abroad, or raise something from obscurity to fame
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of making a matter or person widely talked about or known.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to make someone hear abusive, foul, or insulting speech; revile
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II use involving making another hear what is evil or offensive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to tell or inform someone of a thing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative communicative use distinct from merely making a sound audible.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to cause deafness or invoke deafness against someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a maledictory expression wishing that a person not be made to hear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to sing or perform for others to hear
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a singer, especially in the imperative addressed to a female singer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to say something worthy of being heard and followed
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional evaluative use describing an excellent or authoritative saying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to fit an ear-like loop or attachment to a bucket or basket
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical use for attaching the loop or its paired wooden supports used in drawing a vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: making something heard; hearing it by hearsay or through a report
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These nouns can function as nominal substitutes for the causative of hearing and can describe receiving information from another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the brain
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed anatomical expression, literally associated with the seat or source of hearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: what is heard, including a report, discourse, or received item of knowledge
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This includes received hearsay and, in technical usage, material established through transmitted or received usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a thing that rests in or reaches the ear and is heard
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A result or content-of-hearing use rather than the auditory faculty itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a report heard of but not encountered or fulfilled
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the prayer سِمْعًا لَا بَلْغًا for calamity or unwelcome news that may be heard but not come to the speaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: fame, report, or good reputation
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote what is heard about a person and hence his public reputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a mongrel beast of prey, described as the offspring of a wolf and a hyena
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological noun unrelated to the ordinary auditory sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a single act of hearing, hearkening, or listening
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A count noun referring to one hearing or instance of listening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: publicity or reputation sought by making an act known and talked about
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often paired with رِيَاءً for an action performed to be seen and heard of by people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a manner or quality of hearing or listening
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the way in which something is heard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a woman who listens and tries to see, then forms an opinion despite hearing or seeing nothing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive epithet for a woman characterized by this habitual behavior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: small or slight, light and quick, clever or cunning
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive descriptive epithet applied to people and, in one use, to a wolf.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a woman who grins or frowns on someone's arrival and wails after his departure
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use of the same epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a tall and slender man
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct adjectival use applied to a person of that build.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a wicked, deceitful, or crafty devil
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or zoological-descriptive epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: hear!
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An imperative verbal noun functioning as an exhortation or command.

other_classical_meanings.definition: singing, song, or any pleasant musical sound enjoyed by the ears
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may include vocal or instrumental performance and other agreeable sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: made to hear or told
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical adjectival use distinct from the Quranic divine epithet and from the ordinary adjective meaning hearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the two long wooden pieces fixed in a ploughing yoke
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: relating to what has been received by hearsay or established by transmitted usage
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term in lexicology and grammar.

other_classical_meanings.definition: light, active, or agile
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive epithet, also applied to a ghoul.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a spy who searches for information and brings it
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized extension of habitual listening and relaying information.

other_classical_meanings.definition: obedient
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed or figurative extension from listening to compliance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a hearing or attentive ear, especially one quick to catch faint sounds
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of an animal, especially a lion, that detects distant sounds of people or prey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a lion capable of hearing faint sounds from afar
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological application of the epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a place from which or in which one hears or listens
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing someone within sight and hearing or in a position to be heard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a shackle
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative technical application of the active-participial form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an instrument of hearing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun for an implement associated with hearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the two wooden pieces inserted into the loops of a basket for drawing earth from a well
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical plural or dual use related to ear-like attachments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a pair of socks or stockings worn by a hunter pursuing gazelles in intense heat
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized hunting term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: shackled
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive-participial use, especially in the expression describing someone shackled and collared.

other_classical_meanings.definition: things heard
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural noun for heard reports, sounds, or items of auditory knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the bodily openings or holes
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural use extended beyond the ear to include such openings as the eyes, nostrils, and anus.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to feign hearing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VI use in which one pretends to hear.

lane_unit_coverage.note: A disputed alleged use meaning that the ear saw; the passage itself rejects it as corrupt or non-Arabic.
Pointer to the Form II entry.
The exclamatory construction is represented under the Form IV Quranic sense.
Pointer to the Form V use represented from the linked primary discussion.
The feigned-hearing use is retained as a distinct classical branch.
Pointer-only entry for an unattested Form X derivative.
The emphatic expression of hearing and obeying is covered by the broader acceptance, assent, and compliance branch.
Pointer to an already covered adjectival use.

cautions: The Quranic expression غَيْرَ مُسْمَعٍ has several reported interpretations, including an imprecation not to be made to hear and hypocritical or non-acceptance interpretations; it should not be reduced to one English gloss.
The Form IV exclamatory construction أَسْمِعْ بِهِ is grammatically distinct from ordinary causative أَسْمَعَ.
The Quranic plural سَمَّاعُونَ is displayed under the normalized singular citation form سَمَّاع.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:smE:42148:g1:sub6 records a disputed alleged use in which the ear is said to see; the source itself rejects it as corrupt or non-Arabic, so it is not assigned as a dictionary meaning.
